packageRules.description: export/ runs the vendored kev (vendor/kev) and has to reproduce its reference numbers, so it keeps kev's own pins (Python >=3.12,<3.14 and torch >=2.6,<2.9 as of f153596; upstream capped Python so uv finds torch wheels). No CI job builds the export, so a bump here would be untested. Move these pins when the submodule moves them.
